edits.value_json: "吧 is commonly a sentence-final particle. It is analyzed with 口 as a semantic component and 巴 as a sound component: their Mandarin readings are bā and ba. This comparison applies to the particle, not the separate bar use."
"巴 is 吧’s sound component: both read bā/ba in Mandarin in the particle use. This comparison does not explain the separate bar use."
